主要内容: On March 1, 2016, SanDisk Corporation issued a press release announcing that it had issued notices to holders of its outstanding 1.5% Convertible Senior Notes due 2017 and 0.5% Convertible Senior Notes due 2020 regarding an anticipated Designated Event and Fundamental Change. The notices were sent to holders of these notes, and copies of the press release and notices were attached to the Form 8-K filing. The announcement was part of SanDisk's communication regarding potential changes that could affect the terms of the notes. The document also includes forward-looking statements about the proposed merger and its implications for the company's business and industry. This document is an 8-K filing by SanDisk Corporation dated March 1, 2016, which outlines forward-looking statements related to a proposed merger with Western Digital's subsidiary, Schrader Acquisition Corporation. The filing highlights the potential benefits of the merger and the expected closing date. However, it also emphasizes the risks and uncertainties associated with the merger, including the possibility of not obtaining stockholder approvals, regulatory delays, integration challenges, and potential adverse effects on business relationships. The document warns that these forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future results and are subject to various risks. The filing also notes that the risks associated with the merger are more fully discussed in the joint proxy statement/prospectus included in the Registration Statement on Form S-4 filed with the SEC. The forward-looking statements in this document are only as of the date of the particular statement, and neither SanDisk nor Western Digital undertakes any obligation to revise or update them. SanDisk Corporation announced on March 1, 2016, that it had entered into a conversion agreement for its 0.5% Convertible Senior Notes due 2020. The filing indicates that the conversion process was anticipated and that the terms were set forth in the agreement. This event is significant for the holders of the notes as it affects their potential conversion into equity. The event is relevant to the company's capital structure and shareholder equity, and it may impact the company's financial position and stock price. Additionally, SanDisk Corporation filed an 8-K on March 1, 2016, announcing a proposed merger with Western Digital. The filing includes information about the transaction, which will be submitted to the stockholders of both companies. Western Digital filed a Registration Statement on Form S-4 with the SEC, which was declared effective on February 5, 2016. The joint proxy statement/prospectus is being provided to the stockholders of both companies. Investors are urged to read the documents carefully as they contain important information about the proposed merger. The documents can be accessed on the SEC's website and the websites of SanDisk and Western Digital.
